author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: van with rounded front, belt line, window divider continuing up as a flagpole, swallowtail flag to the right, two wheel arcs; follows the reference's arrangement. The rejected drawing was a heavy block with a merged flag.
omissions: None; wheels drawn as arcs hanging from the body line instead of full circles overlapping it.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L on an 8-unit vertical rhythm: flag y 4..12 (x 22..40, notch to 35), roof 20, belt 28, bottom 36, wheels r5 to 44; r8 front curve, r3 rear corners; pole/divider at x 22.
